title: Little progress reverse-engineering recovered craft: caveman with a USB drive

tellings.quote: I don't think we've done much with what we've recovered. I think it's like uh you know, um caveman with a USB drive.

plain: Whatever craft the United States has recovered since around 1947, it has not done much with them, like a caveman holding a USB drive. Michels offers this as his own opinion, not citing anyone, meaning that even if the objects exist, the technology may be far beyond our ability to understand it.
